hypotheses.justification: `LiesOverPrime A p` is defined (Definitions/Def_FLTPrelim_Ramification.lean) as `(p : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ∈ A.nonunits`. The theorem also takes `[CharP (ResidueField ↥A) p]`, which implies this. By `map_natCast` and `CharP.cast_eq_zero`, `IsLocalRing.residue A (p : A) = (p : ResidueField A) = 0`. Then `IsLocalRing.residue_eq_zero_iff` (Mathlib/RingTheory/LocalRing/ResidueField/Basic.lean) gives `(p : A) ∈ maximalIdeal A`. Then `ValuationSubring.coe_mem_nonunits_iff` gives `((p : A) : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ∈ A.nonunits`, which is `(p : AlgebraicClosure ℚ) ∈ A.nonunits` after a `simp` cast step. The proof uses `hA` only as an argument to `exists_mem_dom_evalAt_eq_root`; replace it there with this derived fact (e.g. `have hA : A.LiesOverPrime p := ...` at the start of the proof), and the rest of the proof is unchanged. No degenerate case matters, because the derivation only uses the `CharP` instance, which stays a hypothesis.
